column2: Provide a structured overview of the week’s learning, including the weekly focus, key learning objectives, and specific activities planned for each day. This section should show how lessons build upon each other, support curriculum goals, and cater to student needs. It serves as a roadmap for instruction, helping with pacing, continuity, and classroom organization.

Record observations, reflections, or feedback about how the Week went. This may include what worked well, what could be improved, how students responded, and any adjustments needed for future teaching. It can also capture emerging student needs, ideas for follow-up, or insights for professional growth.

List all materials, tools, texts, digital content, or equipment needed to support the delivery of the lessons and student engagement. Include any teacher-prepared materials and links to external sources or learning platforms.
